body:
### Summary

in my workplace, we are forced to use an internal registry with the following issues:

- it's less secure than just using the regular pypi one, because it does not support the metadata required for `exclude-newer` to work
- it's very slow to resolve dependencies

so i'm wondering if it could be possible to configure uv to resolve dependencies with the upstream pypi index, but actually download them from the internal registry.

### Example

```toml
[[index]]
name = "pypi"
url = "https://pypi.org/simple/"
default = true
resolve = true # maybe something like this?

[[proxy-index]]
name = "pypi-proxy"
url = "https://proxy.example.com/simple/"
artifact-base-url = "https://proxy.example.com/files/"
proxy-for = "pypi"
```
title: proxy indexes - option to resolve dependencies with one index and download from another
